test: For every rolling origin of planarena.models.rolling (horizons of one, three and five years; decision years 2016-2024), the model is refitted exactly as there (training pairs known by the decision year, first seed) and its test-period probabilities are checked with planarena.models.integration.calibration: reliability in ten equal-count bins, expected calibration error over those bins, observed over predicted events, calibration intercept and slope, and the Brier score against a constant forecast of the training-period prevalence. The same is reported after the temporal isotonic recalibration defined in rolling.py (fitted on the latest training pair, predicted by a model trained on the pairs before it), and after logistic recalibration fitted on out-of-fold probabilities of the training pairs (five spatial folds); neither uses test-period information.
